text:
In Japan, a 30-year-old house can be worth almost nothing. The land keeps its value, the building doesn't.

Tax rules give a wooden house a useful life of 22 years. Most buyers want new. Homes there get demolished at about 32 years, versus about 66 in the US and 80 in the UK.

So in Japan you're really buying the land. Would you buy a house knowing it's worth almost nothing in 30 years? #realestate
